scripts.dev: cross-env AMBIENTE_APP=development NODE_ENV=development npm run dev:completo -w server
scripts.test: cross-env AMBIENTE_APP=development NODE_ENV=development npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && npm run test -w site
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w site
scripts.stylelint: npm run stylelint -w web && npm run stylelint -w site
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w site
scripts.start: cross-env AMBIENTE_APP=production NODE_ENV=production npm run start -w server
scripts.verificar: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run stylelint && npm run test
scripts.dev:semear-demo: cross-env AMBIENTE_APP=development NODE_ENV=development npm run dev:semear-demo -w server
scripts.dev:avancar-ciclo: cross-env AMBIENTE_APP=development NODE_ENV=development npm run dev:avancar-ciclo -w server --
